violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The irreversible temperature measuring device read 144ºF in two consecutive cycles.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. The manager took the unit out of service and submitted a work order to correct. The onsite tech was not able to resolve the issue and will need to order parts for further service. All utensils and equipment will be manually sanitized with quaternary ammonia until the unit is serviced and repaired. Please contact your EHS when the unit is repaired and working properly.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 2% milk in carafe (48F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the 2% milk during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: EHS observed sandwiches that were prepared and being cooled, placed in a display cooler, which is not sufficient cooling equipment.
violations.corrective_action: EHS educated the CFM on properly cooling potentially hazardous food items to appropriate temperatures, using adequate cooling equipment, before placing in the display case.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device in the food establishment.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM was able to obtain a food thermometer for use in the food establishment during the inspection.
